_doc: Exact spec + full describe/title quarantine; the title identifies the affected backend or viewport suite.
Only this known test may pass on retry. Other tests in the spec remain blocking.
owner is the accountable GitHub user; evidence links the observed failed run.
expires is inclusive UTC; after this date flakes block again. Review before expiry using the measured exit criteria; never extend automatically.
Missing or invalid policy fields fail closed. The spec still gets an isolated retrying shard while its exact-test policy is active.

signature (optional; required on rows since 2026-10-26): a case-sensitive regex source starting with ^, matched against the retried attempt's first error line with ANSI codes and a leading 'Error: ' removed (flaky-policy.mjs errorLine). The row then exempts only that failure; the same test failing with any other message still blocks. Several rows may name one spec, one per exact title.

quarantine.why: Cold TLX prepareRace may give up after 30 s: run 37238728678 observed state:count, preparing:false, prepared:false, renders:0. Only the TLX preparation test is exempt; GLX and other TLX mirror tests remain blocking.
